name: nmg-plugins
description: Nunley Media Group plugins for structured software delivery

plugins.name: nmg-sdlc
plugins.description: Spec-driven delivery for Claude Code and Herdr: groomed issues, approved BDD specs in native plan mode, and automated implement/verify/deliver workers.

plugins.name: nmg-router
plugins.description: Puts non-Claude models into Claude Code's /model picker through the user's own provider logins, with an Anthropic guard on every routed request.

plugins.name: nmg-game-dev
plugins.description: Blender-first, Unreal-shipped content pipeline for NMG games: freeform asset authoring in Blender via MCP, checked by an asset contract and finalized into Desktop and Mobile variants in Unreal Engine.
